header: This is the one switch of the whole password module. Everything below is built, tested and ready, and does nothing while this is false:
- the "Change password" item in the account menu and its window,
- the 180-day life and the window that comes up by itself after sign-in when it has run out,
- the last-5-passwords rule, the three no-copy-paste boxes,
- the one-time-code step (which has its own second switch, PASSWORD_OTP on the host, and still needs an SMS / e-mail gateway: src/lib/security/otpSender.ts),
- the "first time? change it" line on the sign-in screen,
- the two server routes under src/app/api/account/password (they answer 404, touch no table and send nothing).

To bring the module into use, change false to true here, commit and deploy. Nothing else needs to change. (Signing in with the SAIL P.No. and the HOD's password set by scripts/set-user-password.ts are not part of this module and work either way.) I keep this a plain constant with no imports: the screens and the server routes both read it.
behaviours: the switch is a plain boolean
GET of the password route is closed first thing when off
POST of the password route is closed first thing when off
the one-time-code route is closed when off
the menu item is shown only when on
the window is rendered only when on
no expiry request is made when off
the sign-in screen's change-password line is shown only when on
